Construction Services in Colwich, KS

Colwich is a small Sedgwick County community of roughly 2,200 residents on the northwest edge of the Wichita metro, along K-96 in the rolling terrain near the Little Arkansas River. The area has a mix of older in-town housing and rural acreage properties on Sedgwick County routes north and west — drawing homeowners who want the space and quiet of a smaller community while staying connected to Wichita.

Wheatland Construction serves Colwich and northwest Sedgwick County. We permit through the City of Colwich for in-town work and through Sedgwick County for rural properties on county routes.

What We Build in Colwich

Custom Homes

Colwich-area rural acreage is a draw for homeowners building custom homes outside the metro. We build from foundation through finish on Colwich-area lots — handling permits and all construction directly with our own crews. See Custom Home Building in Colwich →

Home Additions

Colwich's in-town housing stock includes modest-sized homes where families have outgrown the original footprint. Room additions, garage expansions, and master suite buildouts give homeowners more space without relocating. See Home Additions in Colwich →

Basement Finishing

Colwich-area homes include older properties with basements that haven't been finished — and newer homes where basements were roughed in but never completed. The Little Arkansas River valley area has varying soil drainage characteristics that we assess before any framing begins. See Basement Finishing in Colwich →

Bathroom Remodeling

Colwich's older homes carry original mid-century bathrooms that have been in service for 50 to 70 years. We remodel them completely — new tile, new vanity, new fixtures, and updated plumbing where the original supply or drain systems need replacing. See Bathroom Remodeling in Colwich →

Kitchen Remodeling

Colwich kitchens range from narrow original layouts in older homes to more functional layouts in newer construction that simply need updating. We work with what makes sense and reconfigure what doesn't — always with permits, always with our own crews. See Kitchen Remodeling in Colwich →

Major Remodels

Older Colwich properties often need more than targeted updates — comprehensive renovation projects where multiple rooms and systems get addressed at once. We handle major remodel scopes with coordinated trades and Sedgwick County permit management. See Major Remodels in Colwich →

Roofing

Northwest Sedgwick County sees strong spring storm exposure — wind and hail are seasonal realities in this part of Kansas. We install roofing systems appropriate for the conditions and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Colwich →

Colwich Permit Jurisdiction

In-town Colwich properties permit through the City of Colwich. Rural Sedgwick County properties outside city limits permit through Sedgwick County. We handle all applications and inspections.
